weaknesses: No negative test cases for invalid or out‑of‑range threshold values.
Event log assertions are vague; they do not verify specific log details such as timestamps or alarm identifiers.
No tests for alarm reset functionality after an alarm has fired.
No tests to confirm that alarms do not fire when thresholds are not exceeded or when fewer than 3 consecutive breaths exceed the threshold.
Boundary values are tested only at the extremes; no tests for values just below or above the limits (e.g., 79, 3001, 4, 151).
